newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania c.bank reserves rise to $2.136 bln in July.
newsitem.headline: Romania c.bank reserves rise to $2.136 bln in July.

text.p: The Romanian central bank's total foreign exchange reserves rose to $2.136 billion at end-July from $1.966 billion in June as the bank continued to mop up excess dollars from the local market, official data showed on Monday.
Officials estimated reserves would grow further, putting the year-end forecast at between $3 to $4 billion.
Central bank (BNR) data also showed foreign reserve assets in the banking system rose to $3.73 billion in June from $3.27 billion in May. Figures on July reserve assets were not available.
End-June reserve assets include gold reserves of about 90 tonnes, Special Drawing Rights and hard currency reserves of local banks and of the BNR.
